name: The archmage
description: The head of the Lat-Nam academy, who in the final scene transforms into a gray-skinned, tentacled woman who is pleased by Jared's involvement.

timeline.summary: The archmage reveals himself to be a gray-skinned tentacled woman, pleased that Jared found the book.
